focus.title: 美国对华半导体出口管制加码，欧盟碳边境调整机制进入过渡期
focus.summary: 本周，美国商务部工业安全局（BIS）发布新规，扩大对华半导体制造设备及EDA软件的出口限制，并新增多家中国实体至实体清单。同时，欧盟碳边境调整机制（CBAM）于6月15日正式进入过渡期，首批覆盖钢铁、铝、水泥等行业，要求进口商报告碳排放数据。两大动向叠加，凸显全球供应链重构与绿色贸易壁垒双重压力，中国出海企业需加速合规能力建设，尤其需关注半导体供应链替代方案及碳核算体系搭建。
focus.source: 来源：美国联邦公报（Federal Register）· 2026年6月16日；欧盟官方公报（Official Journal of the EU）· 2026年6月15日
focus.title_en: US Tightens Semiconductor Export Controls on China; EU CBAM Enters Transition Period
focus.summary_en: This week, the US Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) issued new rules expanding export restrictions on semiconductor manufacturing equipment and EDA software to China, adding several Chinese entities to the Entity List. Meanwhile, the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) officially entered its transitional phase on June 15, initially covering steel, aluminum, cement, and other sectors, requiring importers to report carbon emission data. The dual developments highlight the reshaping of global supply chains and the rise of green trade barriers, urging Chinese companies to accelerate compliance capabilities, especially in semiconductor supply chain alternatives and carbon accounting systems.
focus.source_en: Source: US Federal Register · June 16, 2026; Official Journal of the European Union · June 15, 2026

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁中心裁决：中国企业与东南亚合资方争议，适用中国法仲裁条款获支持
case.summary: 本周，新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC）就一起中国企业与东南亚合资方的股权纠纷作出部分裁决，确认合资协议中的中国法仲裁条款有效，驳回了外方关于适用当地法的请求。该案涉及合资企业控制权及利润分配争议，仲裁庭认定双方明确约定中国法为准据法，且仲裁地新加坡不影响法律适用。此案启示中国出海企业：在跨境合资协议中明确约定争议解决条款，并保留书面证据，可有效降低境外诉讼风险。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC）案件摘要 · 2026年6月17日
case.title_en: SIAC Partial Award: Chinese Law Arbitration Clause Upheld in China-Southeast Asia Joint Venture Dispute
case.summary_en: This week, the Singapore International Arbitration Center (SIAC) issued a partial award in a shareholding dispute between a Chinese company and a Southeast Asian joint venture partner, confirming the validity of a Chinese law arbitration clause in the joint venture agreement and rejecting the foreign party's request to apply local law. The dispute involved control rights and profit distribution. The tribunal found that both parties clearly agreed on Chinese governing law, and the Singapore seat did not affect legal application. The case advises Chinese companies to clearly define dispute resolution clauses in cross-border joint venture agreements and maintain written evidence to reduce overseas litigation risks.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动新规落地，深圳前海试点企业数据出境简化流程
policy.summary: 本周，广东省互联网信息办公室发布《粤港澳大湾区数据跨境流动安全管理规范（试行）》，在深圳前海蛇口自贸片区率先试点企业数据出境简化流程。新规明确对非重要数据和个人信息出境实行负面清单管理，清单外数据可凭合规声明直接出境，无需逐项审批。同时，要求企业建立数据分类分级制度及内部合规审计机制。此举将大幅降低大湾区企业跨境数据传输合规成本，但企业仍需警惕涉及金融、医疗等敏感领域的特殊要求。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室 · 2026年6月18日
policy.title_en: New Cross-Border Data Flow Rules for Greater Bay Area: Simplified Exit for Enterprise Data Piloted in Shenzhen Qianhai
policy.summary_en: This week, the Guangdong Provincial Cyberspace Administration issued the 'Cross-Border Data Flow Security Management Regulations for the Greater Bay Area (Trial)', piloting simplified data exit procedures for enterprises in the Shenzhen Qianhai Shekou Free Trade Zone. The new rules introduce a negative list management approach for non-important data and personal information; data not on the list can exit with a compliance declaration without case-by-case approval. Enterprises are also required to establish data classification and internal compliance audit mechanisms. This will significantly reduce compliance costs for cross-border data transfers, but companies must still watch special requirements in sensitive sectors like finance and healthcare.
policy.source_en: Source: Guangdong Provincial Cyberspace Administration · June 18, 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师周度研判：美国管制与欧盟碳关税双重压力下，出海企业应构建“合规+绿色”双轨战略
analysis.summary: 本周美国出口管制升级与欧盟CBAM启动，标志着国际经贸规则从传统关税向技术封锁与碳壁垒并行转变。建议出海企业：一、立即梳理供应链中涉及美国管制物项（如半导体设备、EDA软件）的环节，评估替代来源或申请许可；二、建立产品全生命周期碳足迹核算体系，尤其对出口欧盟的钢铁、铝等产品，需从2026年10月起准备正式申报；三、善用大湾区数据跨境流动新规，优化全球数据合规架构。下周关注：美国可能进一步限制AI芯片对华出口，及欧盟CBAM过渡期首月企业报告实践。
analysis.source: 来源：秦林蒿律师 · 律连全球iGlobal Law 涉外法律团队
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's Weekly View: Under Dual Pressure of US Controls and EU Carbon Tariffs, Outbound Firms Should Build 'Compliance + Green' Dual-Track Strategy
analysis.summary_en: This week's escalation of US export controls and the launch of the EU CBAM signal a shift in international trade rules from traditional tariffs to a combination of technology blockade and carbon barriers. Recommendations for outbound enterprises: First, promptly review supply chain links involving US-controlled items (e.g., semiconductor equipment, EDA software) and assess alternative sources or apply for licenses; second, establish a product lifecycle carbon footprint accounting system, especially for steel and aluminum exported to the EU, with formal declarations required from October 2026; third, leverage the new Greater Bay Area cross-border data flow rules to optimize global data compliance structures. Next week watch: potential further US restrictions on AI chip exports to China, and initial enterprise reporting practices under the EU CBAM transitional phase.
analysis.source_en: Source: Attorney Qin Linhao · iGlobal Law Cross-Border Legal Team
